summary.title: Weekly Product Sync
summary.summary: The team confirmed the app launch date for October 25th, despite ongoing issues with the payment module. Engineering will finalize the payment module by October 18th, while design will streamline the onboarding process to three screens. Marketing will produce an in-house launch video, with a script draft due next Wednesday. The team also agreed to hold a follow-up check-in on October 15th to monitor progress.

decisions.context: The team confirmed the timeline after accounting for the payment module fix

decisions.decision: Reduce onboarding design to three screens
decisions.context: The team agreed five screens was too long for new users
There is no budget available for an external agency

action_items.task: Send final onboarding designs to Priya

Set up a check-in meeting invite for the 15th

open_items.issue: Investigate the increase in server costs
open_items.reason: The team did not have time to assign this task during the meeting

email:
Subject: Follow-up: Weekly Product Sync

Dear Team,

We met today to align on the upcoming product launch and address outstanding development tasks. We confirmed the launch date for October 25th and finalized key design and marketing strategy decisions.

Decisions:
- Launch date set for October 25th
- Reduce onboarding design to three screens
- Produce the launch video in-house

Action Items:
- Send final onboarding designs to Priya (Ananya, Friday)
- Prepare a launch video script draft (Karan, Wednesday)
- Fix payment bug and send test report to the team (Priya, 18th)
- Set up a check-in meeting invite for the 15th (Karan)

Still open:
- Investigate the increase in server costs

Thank you for your hard work and focus on these deliverables.

Best regards,

Meeting Assistant
